## What's Changed
* Feature: added `idempotencyKey` on transaction action requested webhooks by @lkostrowski in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19813
* Upgraded pyjwt to 2.15.0 to fix GHSA-x33g-cr3x-6449, GHSA-42vr-xj54-vc7v by @NyanKiyoshi in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19824


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/saleor/saleor/compare/3.23.35...3.23.36

> [!CAUTION]
> This is the **last release** for Saleor 3.21. Upgrade as soon as possible to **3.23** to continue receiving security and bug fixes.

## What's Changed
* Upgraded pyjwt to 2.15.0 to fix GHSA-x33g-cr3x-6449, GHSA-42vr-xj54-vc7v by @NyanKiyoshi in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19826

## What's Changed
* Fix `giftCardBulkCreate` removing existing tags from previously created gift cards by @przlada in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19794
* Release 3.22.70 by @przlada in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19807


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/saleor/saleor/compare/3.22.69...3.22.70

## What's Changed
* Feat/translate media alt by @EugenBodanov in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19727
* Store order base prices in dedicated columns so a dropped tax calculation cannot leave untaxed totals by @wcislo-saleor in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19801
* Fix `giftCardBulkCreate` removing existing tags from previously created gift cards by @przlada in https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19803
